name: Kavita Singh

sections.heading: Life and writing.
paragraphs: Kavita Singh writes under the pen name ‘Prabha’ and works across Hindi poetry, ghazals, songs and theatre. An educator, she describes directing plays and creating dance dramas for children as part of her creative life. Her author website brings teaching and literary practice together through poems, performances and work promoting Hindi.

Her Kabita Live poems turn inward feelings into direct appeals to the reader. ‘क्रोध’ asks for restraint and compassion in the face of anger; ‘इंतज़ार’ gives voice to parents waiting for their grown children to return. In ‘यह तृषा है!’, thirst becomes a wider image of human longing, capable of both disturbing the heart and sustaining its dreams.
